question.text: A Category III AIF taking an UNHEDGED position in Credit Default Swaps must ensure that gross unhedged positions do NOT exceed:

answer.text: 25% of investable funds of the scheme
50% of investable funds of the scheme

explanation.text: The Logic: Gross unhedged CDS positions of a Category III AIF should be up to 25% of investable funds of the scheme. The Trap: 10%, 50% and 100% are not the prescribed threshold. Note: A position exceeding 25% of investable funds may be taken after intimating all unit-holders.
